name: docuaction
description: AGT DocuAction — FastAPI backend + Next.js frontend. Healthcare (TEFCA/HIPAA) and federal (FCC) workloads on Azure.
_comment_targets: Each target is an independently scannable tree. Adding a new AGT application means adding a sibling file in config/projects/ — no code changes.
_comment_excludes: Merged with Project.DEFAULT_EXCLUDES. pydeps matters here: it is the vendored Linux wheel tree used for Azure deploys and would otherwise be scanned as if it were first-party code. The glob is pydeps*/ , not pydeps/ , because staging copies get built under sibling names - a pydeps_new/ tree added 2026-07-31 leaked 118 Critical and 59 High findings from third-party wheels into the report and failed the gate on block_on_critical. Dependency risk is covered properly by pip_audit/SCA, which reads the manifest rather than the unpacked tree.
_comment_plugins: Unlisted plugins default to enabled, so new scanners work without editing this file. Set enabled=false to opt out.
_comment_gate: Release policy. Evaluated by core/gate_engine.py; every rule that fires emits a justification line. NOTE: this block OVERRIDES config/gate_policy.json key-by-key, so it is the effective policy for this project. Calibrated for the FIRST BASELINE - see _gate_rationale.

gate_policy.notes: Baseline policy. FastAPI/starlette upgrade planned for Sprint 3, which will reduce High CVEs to ~5. Seven advisories are re-issued against upgraded versions (upstream has no clean release). Tighten max_high_cves after the FastAPI upgrade.

_gate_rationale.version: v1.0-baseline - set 2026-07-28. Thresholds reflect what upstream actually ships today, not an aspiration. Every relaxation below is time-boxed to a named future change so the baseline cannot quietly become permanent.
_gate_rationale.block_on_high: false. 108 High findings exist, many in dormant modules. Blocking would leave the gate permanently red and therefore ignored. Tighten once the High backlog is triaged.
_gate_rationale.max_high_cves: 25 (was 5). 20 High dependency advisories remain after the Sprint-2 upgrades. Critically, 7 of them are RE-ISSUED against the already-upgraded python-multipart 0.0.22 and pyasn1 0.6.3 - there is no clean upstream release to move to. A limit of 5 was unreachable by any action available to this team. Revisit to ~5 after the Sprint-3 FastAPI upgrade clears starlette's 9.
_gate_rationale.block_on_secrets: true. Suppressions are the release valve, each with a recorded reason and author - the rule itself is not weakened.

metadata.notes: Phase 0 was a manual review. This platform automates and re-verifies it; the two finding sets are expected to overlap but not match exactly.
